Facts:

- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (not advanced)

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.
- Role owns Source Code: Engineer owns Source Code. But contractor never admin anyway.

So maximum is read (no advanced training). Requested admin > max, grant max = read.

Decision: read.
